verdict.rationale: An email-client SaaS could plausibly publish a public API with a machine-readable spec, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no Shortwave API or spec, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Its MCP-client integrations and its own use of Gmail's APIs are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
